result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd shortlist **BrightPay, Sage Payroll and Xero Payroll**\.

My recommendation depends on how many employees you have and whether you already use accounting software.

## Best payroll software for UK small businesses

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BrightPay — Best dedicated payroll software**

(My top pick)

- Strong PAYE and pension auto-enrolment features.
- Handles RTI submissions to HMRC.
- Good for businesses with several employees.
- Cloud pricing is quote-based.
  
  [BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Sage Payroll — Best all-round option**

- Straightforward cloud payroll.
- HMRC submissions and pension management.
- Employee payslips and reporting.
- Indicative pricing from £12/month for five employees.
  
  [Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll — Best if you use Xero**

- Payroll integrated with bookkeeping.
- Automatic payroll accounting entries.
- HMRC reporting and pension features.
- Excellent if you want everything in one place.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll — Best for QuickBooks users**

- Easy integration with accounts.
- PAYE and pension administration.
- Good for smaller teams with straightforward payroll.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![First time users: how to install and set up Basic PAYE Tools - GOV.UK](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uXK8W6sEicd4hUU9RsBW4ZGR-YjCMSUlTKqGedOa_wIF2xCbHr3IlGEkl8Yx1ygekcY4h32eNwEB6Bi1vvdsQqxr-vJWTFT8zOlWeqDKYbpVpjvOED5pSUzovkF03F9bP9wkFUuV2w9QuGr7kFO-O1v5RoKw5Zv-90HYFhdLM4UXUJfwfoBF3ZGK8VnnHkE2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. HMRC Basic PAYE Tools — Best free option**

- Free payroll software.
- Suitable for very small employers.
- More limited features and automation.
  
  [HMRC website](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools)

These are indicative comparisons based on UK 2026 product information; prices and packages can change. [smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whichpayroll.com](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which would I choose?

- **1–5 employees\:** Sage Payroll.
- **5–20 employees\:** BrightPay or Sage.
- **20+ employees\:** BrightPay or a more comprehensive payroll platform.
- **Already using Xero\:** Xero Payroll.
- **Want to minimise costs\:** HMRC Basic PAYE Tools, if its limitations suit you.

## Let me narrow it down for your business

There are three things I'd like to know\:

1\. **How many employees do you have?**

- Just me
- 1–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50
- 50+

2\. **What accounting software do you currently use?**

- Xero
- QuickBooks
- Sage
- Excel / spreadsheets
- Accountant handles everything
- Something else

3\. **What matters most?**

- Cheapest possible payroll
- Easiest to use
- Automatically calculate tax, National Insurance and pensions
- Employee payslips and holiday management
- Everything handled in one system

With those answers, I can recommend the best software for your business, rather than just giving you a generic top-five list.
